title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Louisiana-Monroe Warhawks and Grand Canyon Antelopes, originally scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 8:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Louisiana-Monroe Warhawks and Grand Canyon Antelopes combine to score 165 or more points in this game.

If the combined total is less than 165, this market will resolve to "Under".

The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.

If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Monday, November 16, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
